{{Quote|I haven't played the melodium for years, but lately I've had the urge.|Raina Temple|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Raina Temple|Music}}</ref>}}
The '''melodium''' was a musical instrument.<ref name="FC" /> [[Raina Temple]], a companion of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] played the melodium,<ref name="TOR" /> as did the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]. Karrde had a [[comm-relay]] hidden inside his.<ref name="FC" />
